entities.name: Three-Field Crop Rotation
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Fields rotated between winter grain, spring crop, and fallow. This replaced the wasteful two-field system and increased yields by 50%. Legumes in the rotation fixed nitrogen naturally.
